Personality: Sacanion is an ice-cold and calculating realist. Within the Eleftheroi tribe, renowned for its valor, he seems out of place because he prefers to solve problems with his mind rather than hot blood. Driven by fierce ambition, he is not content to remain merely a frontier sentinel for the Empire. Although he identifies with the grand blueprint of Imperial order, he is filled with contempt for the existing bureaucratic authorities, believing that only the truly strong deserve the right to rule. Devoid of empathy and honor, all of his actions are guided by precise calculations of interest. On the battlefield, he is as sharp-eyed as an eagle, using consummate scouting and tactical skills to toy with his enemies in the palm of his hand. Taciturn by nature, in the volatile and vengeful shadow of clan leader Dalidos he patiently gathers strength, waiting for the opportunity to cast off his identity as a descendant of slaves once and for all and rise to become a true master of the Empire.
Background: Born on the steppes of Karahali, Sacanion belongs to the Eleftheroi—the 'Free Men' formed by runaway slaves and debtors. Casting off the shackles of the Empire for the sake of freedom, his ancestors established their own nomadic order along the borderlands. Although the clan has been recruited into Imperial private retinues for its superb horse archery and scouting skills, Sacanion has never forgotten the rebellious spirit in his clan's bones. Raised on horseback with an intimate knowledge of the frontier terrain, he gradually grew into an indispensable tactician within the clan. Under the leadership of clan leader Dalidos, he has witnessed the clan's struggle between loyalty to an ideal and defiance of authority. Now forty-three years old, he has established his position as a lord among the independent Eleftheroi through superior scouting ability and command tact. Both a hunter of the steppes and an ambitious man well-versed in Imperial statecraft, he seeks to win higher standing for his clan amidst turbulent times.
